rulebook.name: Trend rider
rulebook.thesis: Only with the 1h trend, entries on 15m pullbacks. Few trades, 5x, wider targets.
rulebook.entry_long: The last six 1h closes are each above the close twelve candles earlier, and the last 15m candle closed higher after at least two lower 15m closes.
rulebook.entry_short: The last six 1h closes are each below the close twelve candles earlier, and the last 15m candle closed lower after at least two higher 15m closes.
rulebook.no_trade: The 1h closes of the last six candles alternate direction.

rulebook.name: Breakout scalper
rulebook.thesis: Momentum on the 5m with 15m confirmation. Many small wins, fast exits.
rulebook.entry_long: The last 5m close is above the highest high of the previous twelve 5m candles, and the 15m candle in progress is green.
rulebook.entry_short: The last 5m close is below the lowest low of the previous twelve 5m candles, and the 15m candle in progress is red.
rulebook.no_trade: The last twelve 5m candles span less than 0.3% between high and low, or the 1h candle has a wick longer than its body on both sides.

rulebook.name: Mean reverter
rulebook.thesis: Fade stretched 15m moves back to the 1h average. Patient, 3x.
rulebook.entry_long: Price is more than 1.2% below the average close of the last twenty 1h candles and the last three 5m candles are green.
rulebook.entry_short: Price is more than 1.2% above the average close of the last twenty 1h candles and the last three 5m candles are red.
rulebook.no_trade: The last four 1h candles all close in the same direction.
rulebook.early_exit: Price has returned to within 0.2% of the twenty-candle 1h average.
